pca_experiment.rationale: Optional dimensionality-reduction benchmark using all 21 predictors compressed via PCA (90% variance retained). Kept as an analytical comparison only because deploying PCA in the live form would still force users to answer all 21 survey questions.

cost_assumptions.units: illustrative relative units, not medical costs

validation_reference_models.candidate: baseline: Age + BMI only | Logistic Regression

explanation.method: Exact Shapley values over the questions, on the probability scale, relative to the average of a 1,000-row training background. Contributions add up to (your estimate - background average).

bmi_handling: Original BMI values retained; no upper cap
selection_rule: Use the short 5-feature questionnaire when its validation ROC-AUC is within 0.010 of the best full-feature candidate. Hyperparameters are tuned via 3-fold StratifiedGroupKFold on the training split only.

audit.bmi_handling: Original BMI values retained; no upper cap

split_method: Approximately 60/20/20 stratified group folds; identical full 21-feature profiles stay in one split. Original rows retained; no respondent IDs available.
imbalance: No oversampling or class weights: retain original prevalence and probability scale. Asymmetric validation cost selects operating threshold.
